navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, 64px tall, 2px brand-red bottom border; app icon + 'StockFlow' title left, nav links right; active link brand-red. --shadow-navbar.

page.notes: warm-oat page bg, centered 960px content column; page__header holds the app icon + page__title. Never a blank region.

card.notes: white surface on warm-oat, --radius-md, navy-tinted --shadow-sm, --space-6 padding; wraps the stock table and detail panels.

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red, sharp 0px corners, hover brand-red-hover), btn--secondary (outlined navy), btn--ghost (text-only); min 44x44px tap target.

form_input.notes: persistent visible label (field__label, never placeholder-only), --radius-sm, focus ring --color-info; inline validation via field__error next to the field, naming the field. 44px min height.

table.notes: cool uppercase navy header row; quantity cells right-aligned in --font-mono with tabular-nums; calm high-contrast rows for scanning.

status_badge.variants: badge--in-stock (success), badge--low (warning), badge--out (error), badge--on-order (info), badge--quarantined (navy-500); pill (--radius-pill), --text-xs uppercase; meaning carried by BOTH text and color, never color alone.

empty_state.notes: line icon + teaching heading + guiding copy + a CTA (e.g. 'No stock at this location, receive an inbound shipment'); never a blank page or blank region. Also used for 'not tracked' detail.

toast.notes: fixed top-right; feedback never shifts page layout.

scan_zone.notes: primary barcode input on the warehouse floor; success flashes green with the stock row updating in place, failure (unknown barcode, locked SKU) flashes red and raises a persistent error toast.

app_icon.notes: warehouse mark from client/src/assets/warehouse.png, shown in navbar and page__header next to 'StockFlow'; favicon references the same asset for the browser tab.
